notes.usage: Any desktop app with a main window works: fill launch/title_pattern, then use PlaytestKit.ps1 keys/hold/shot and tools/probes.
notes.if_keys_ignored: Some apps ignore PostMessage; run PlaytestKit -Action focus first, or switch the backend to a SendInput variant (see CONTRACT.md 4.1).
notes.capture_tip: If PrintWindow returns blank frames the backend automatically falls back to CopyFromScreen; keep the window unoccluded.
